attributes.title: historian_query_aggregate
attributes.description: Calculate validated Historian aggregates across the entire requested range. This is not a time-bucket API.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: Historical paths. Hard maximum 100; each path is limited to 2048 characters.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to 7 days before endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: aggregates
parameters.description: At most 18 validated whole-range calculations before duplicate removal. Supported: Average, SimpleAverage, Sum, Minimum, Maximum, MinMax, LastValue, Range, Count, CountOn, CountOff, DurationOn, DurationOff, Variance, StdDev, PctGood, PctBad.
